A fitting without the interruptions

Choose a template, a speech language and an optional default unit. Tap the microphone and allow access when you are ready to speak.

Say “shoulder fourteen and a half inches, sleeve five and a half inches.” After the readback, speak a correction, or say “review” and then “save.” The microphone resumes after Alavu finishes speaking. Tap it again to stop.

Use Chrome on localhost or HTTPS with an internet connection. Malayalam and mixed-language recognition depend on the browser provider. Readback uses an available device voice and falls back to Indian English.

If recognition is unavailable, open “Use Wispr Flow or a text transcript.” You can dictate there with Flow. Sample transcripts are labeled separately.

Only confirmed cards are kept in this browser. Browser storage can be cleared, so export important measurements. Alavu keeps no audio recordings.
